goal.statement: Demonstrate closed authoring evidence without substituting browser evidence.
goal.context: A deterministic runtime fixture exercises protected candidate authority.

criteria.verification_method: Reopen every persisted record and compare SHA-256

in_scope: Persist state, support, candidate, response, and publication evidence
deferred: Browser traversal is owned by the browser runner

decisions.statement: Use production persistence and dossier APIs for all authority artifacts.
decisions.rationale: Production APIs own validation, identity, and atomic persistence.

assumptions.statement: The local runtime root is fresh and writable.
assumptions.if_wrong: Exclusive evidence creation cannot be proven.

evidence.description: Closed local fixture input for deterministic authoring evidence.

findings.issue: Hand-authored records could bypass authority validation.
findings.impact: Evidence would not prove the production lifecycle.
findings.disposition_rationale: The harness invokes only persistence and candidate APIs.

findings.issue: A static fixture cannot prove browser behavior.
findings.impact: Browser checks require their dedicated runner.
findings.alternative: Keep browser evidence outside this fixture harness.
findings.disposition_rationale: The browser runner is the sole browser-evidence writer.
findings.dissent: The fixture remains intentionally non-browser evidence.

bounded_ambiguities.unknown: The final browser evidence root is assigned by the coordinator.
bounded_ambiguities.resolution_needed: Run the dedicated browser writer after artifact creation.

review_item_presentations.why_it_matters: Exclusive creation is evidence of a fresh root
research_summary: The fixture invokes descriptor-confined production writes

options.label: Fresh root
options.mechanism_or_output: Require the root to be absent before creation
options.omission_cost_or_uncertainty: Requires a new directory per run

options.label: Timestamp child
options.mechanism_or_output: Create a generated child under a shared root

review_item_presentations.recommendation_rationale: A missing root plus exclusive writes gives the smallest strong provenance boundary.
review_item_presentations.uncertainty: Filesystem availability remains an external prerequisite.

research_summary: The manifest is reopened after exclusive creation
review_item_presentations.recommendation_rationale: A closed path/hash list detects omitted and tampered artifacts.
review_item_presentations.uncertainty: The browser validator adds its own evidence closure later.

review_item_presentations.why_it_matters: The harness must not mint trusted records
research_summary: The runtime reopens authority files after writes
review_item_presentations.recommendation_rationale: Only production APIs establish the tested authority chain.
review_item_presentations.uncertainty: Production API contracts remain the single source of truth.

review_item_presentations.why_it_matters: The browser runner needs canonical candidate and support bytes
research_summary: The fixture publishes an approved response before generating handoff
review_item_presentations.recommendation_rationale: The complete lifecycle creates the exact inputs the browser runner validates.

research_summary: Dedicated browser tooling owns Chromium, WebP, and PDF evidence

options.label: Separate runner
options.mechanism_or_output: Emit only its required artifact manifest

review_item_presentations.recommendation_rationale: A separate browser runner is the sole legitimate browser-evidence writer.
review_item_presentations.uncertainty: The assigned browser root is not known while creating canonical artifacts.
